entries.title: Psalms 111:1
segments: ¶Praise the LORD! I will praise the LORD with [my] whole heart, In the assembly of the upright and [in] the congregation.

entries.title: Psalms 111:2
segments: The works of the LORD [are] great, Studied by all who have pleasure in them.

entries.title: Psalms 111:3
segments: His work [is] honorable and glorious, And His righteousness endures forever.

entries.title: Psalms 111:4
segments: He has made His wonderful works to be remembered; The LORD [is] gracious and full of compassion.

entries.title: Psalms 111:5
segments: He has given food to those who fear Him; He will ever be mindful of His covenant.

entries.title: Psalms 111:6
segments: ¶He has declared to His people the power of His works, In giving them the heritage of the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 111:7
segments: The works of His hands [are] verity and justice; All His precepts [are] sure.

entries.title: Psalms 111:8
segments: They stand fast forever and ever, [And are] done in truth and uprightness.

entries.title: Psalms 111:9
segments: He has sent redemption to His people; He has commanded His covenant forever: Holy and awesome [is] His name.

entries.title: Psalms 111:10
segments: The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of wisdom; A good understanding have all those who do [His commandments]. His praise endures forever.
